# Tyler Roofing & Home Solutions

> Family-run, mobile roofing and home services company that comes to you, serving the Birmingham metro and central Alabama since 2023.

Tyler Roofing & Home Solutions was founded by Jacob Tyler in 2023. It's a mobile, come-to-you business: crews work at your home across the Birmingham metro and central Alabama. Roofing is the main work, about 80% of jobs, along with gutters, storm and insurance-claim work, tree removal, painting, drywall, decks and other home solutions. The company says it runs two to three crews and has completed more than 100 jobs since opening.

## Services

- [Roof replacement and repairs](https://tylerroofingandhomesolutions.com/services#roof-replace): Full tear-offs done to spec, plus smaller repairs (leaks, flashing, valleys, pipe boots). Architectural shingle, impact-resistant, and metal roofing. Honest advice on patch versus replace, plus manufacturer warranties.
- [Home solutions](https://tylerroofingandhomesolutions.com/services#home): Interior and exterior painting, gutters, guards, fascia and soffit, drywall, decks, fences, pressure washing, and punch-list work. The homepage also lists windows, siding, floors, and cabinets.
- [Storm damage and insurance claims](https://tylerroofingandhomesolutions.com/storm): Hail and wind claims start to finish — emergency tarping, loss documentation, adjuster meetings, and carrier coordination. See also [storm services](https://tylerroofingandhomesolutions.com/services#storm).
- [Tree removal](https://tylerroofingandhomesolutions.com/services#tree-removal): Storm-downed limbs, hazard trees leaning over the house, full takedowns, cleanup, and haul-off.
- [Roofing materials](https://tylerroofingandhomesolutions.com/materials): Architectural shingles, standing-seam metal, Class 4 impact-resistant shingles, cedar shake, synthetic slate and shake, and low-slope TPO or modified membrane.
- [Financing](https://tylerroofingandhomesolutions.com/financing): Third-party financing partners for replacements and major repairs. Tyler Roofing is not a lender and does not make credit decisions.

## Service Area

Jefferson and Shelby counties are the core service area, roughly a 25-mile radius around Birmingham. Surrounding counties are covered by schedule. If your town isn't listed, call anyway.

- [Service areas](https://tylerroofingandhomesolutions.com/areas): Full town-by-town list.
- Core towns: [Birmingham](https://tylerroofingandhomesolutions.com/areas/birmingham), [Hoover](https://tylerroofingandhomesolutions.com/areas/hoover), [Vestavia Hills](https://tylerroofingandhomesolutions.com/areas/vestavia), [Mountain Brook](https://tylerroofingandhomesolutions.com/areas/mountainbrook), [Homewood](https://tylerroofingandhomesolutions.com/areas/homewood), [Pelham](https://tylerroofingandhomesolutions.com/areas/pelham), [Helena](https://tylerroofingandhomesolutions.com/areas/helena), [Alabaster](https://tylerroofingandhomesolutions.com/areas/alabaster), [Chelsea](https://tylerroofingandhomesolutions.com/areas/chelsea), [Calera](https://tylerroofingandhomesolutions.com/areas/calera), [Columbiana](https://tylerroofingandhomesolutions.com/areas/columbiana), [McCalla](https://tylerroofingandhomesolutions.com/areas/mccalla), [Leeds](https://tylerroofingandhomesolutions.com/areas/leeds).
- Surrounding counties (by schedule): Tuscaloosa, St. Clair, Bibb, Talladega, Blount, Walker, Cullman, Chilton, Coosa and Montgomery. See [service areas](https://tylerroofingandhomesolutions.com/areas) for towns.

## Why Choose Us / Key Facts

- Founded in 2023 by Jacob Tyler. Family-run, local and mobile: we come to you.
- Alabama Roofing License # 31643. Licensed and insured, with general liability and workers' compensation. Certificates available on request.
- Free inspections, no charge and no obligation. A typical visit takes about 20 minutes. Every slope is checked, with a drone when a roof is too steep to walk safely. Photos and a written assessment arrive within 24 to 48 hours.
- 24/7 emergency tarping and storm response.
- Insurance-claim help: we walk the roof with your adjuster, document the loss and coordinate with your carrier.
- Written warranties on every job: workmanship and manufacturer.
- Financing available through third-party partner lenders.
- More than 100 jobs completed since 2023, 2 to 3 crews, and 25 years of combined crew experience.
- Customers can find or leave a Google review through the reviews page.
